drivers.description: YoY revenue growth applied to prior period revenue.
EBIT as % of revenue. Implied by EBITDA margin minus D&A % revenue.
Income tax expense as % of PBT.
Inventory / Cost of Sales × 365. Zero for services companies; material for manufacturing.
Capital expenditure as % of revenue. Drives the canonical.cf.capex line item (the investing-activities line also reflects net other investing flows).
Net change in borrowings. ~0 when the company carries no forecast debt; present for generality.
Risk-free rate + beta × equity risk premium (CAPM).
Pre-tax cost of debt. Falls back to the debt schedule interest rate when unset.
Perpetuity growth rate. Must be < WACC (QA check).
Alternative terminal value via exit multiple.

wacc.source_notes: CAPM: Rfr=5.18% (yfinance live 10-Year US Treasury yield ^TNX (5.18%)), Beta=0.80 (yfinance 2Y weekly beta (0.43, domestic calibrated 0.70), Blume-adjusted), ERP=4.50% (US market default for erp (Equity Risk Premium %)). Cost of Equity=8.78% = Rf + Beta x ERP. Pre-tax Cost of Debt=0.00% (after-tax 0.00%). Capital Weights: Equity=89.8%, Debt=10.2%.

dcf_bridge.debt_basis_note: Net cash = (cash + short-term investments) - total debt. Debt = non-current borrowings + current borrowings (including the current portion of long-term debt) + finance lease liabilities + operating lease liabilities. Non-current investments are not netted. Struck on the most recent reported balance sheet, whose date is shown on this bridge.
